resourcesAndCleanup.scope: These model/runtime/cleanup fields belong to the full fourteen-scene invocation, not eight separately launched profiles.

limitations: Seven complete anchors are absent in the stock source OCR. All seven text scenes still have declared exact paragraph failures; only the wordless scene is strict green.

Raw PNG protected RGBA fails in two scenes at four translucent probes. Native decoded-source preservation passes all eight; decode/premultiply differences are recorded separately and are not repair successes.
The wordless case is manga-only with actual zero source text and noBitmap. It is not admitted to ordinary-image mode.
A unique ORT placement warning has two raw observations and remains blocking because functional quality failed. No claim of warning-free runtime.
The historical source manifest firstOcrStatus remains byte-for-byte the pre-OCR wording; this separate file records subsequent first observation.
No source text, PNG, box, paragraph, negative region or expected pixel was adjusted after OCR. This curation does not imply the current candidate or branch has passed these cases.
